text:
Store transaction history in MongoDB for flexible metadata

Partners keep sending new metadata fields. Let us move transaction history into a MongoDB collection so we can store arbitrary fields without migrations.

Stream payment events through Kafka

We want other teams to subscribe to payment events. Proposal: set up a Kafka cluster and publish payment.created and payment.settled events to it.

Add index on ledger_entries.created_at

Monthly statement queries are slow. Add a btree index on ledger_entries.created_at via an Alembic migration.

Fix typo in onboarding email

The welcome email says recieve instead of receive.

Expose a GraphQL endpoint for partners

Partner X asked for GraphQL so they can fetch accounts and transactions in one round trip. Add /graphql to the public partner API.

Internal admin dashboard: use GraphQL between the React admin UI and the backend-for-frontend

Only our support staff use this internal tool; it is not exposed to partners.

Build our own login page with password reset

Auth0 costs are growing. Let's store bcrypt password hashes in Postgres and build login, password reset and MFA ourselves.

Add Google as a social login option in Auth0

Enable the Google connection in our Auth0 tenant and show the button on the sign-in page.

Settings screen: manage server state with a new Redux slice

Create settingsSlice with thunks to fetch and update user settings from the API.

Use TanStack Query for the new statements page

Fetch statements with useQuery and invalidate on download.

Retry failed payouts automatically

When a payout POST times out, retry it up to 3 times with a fresh request id each time.

Create a separate notifications microservice

Split notification sending out of the ledger into its own service with its own deploy pipeline.

Store FX rates as floats

Add fx_rate and converted_amount float columns so we can show converted amounts quickly.

Hotfix: increase RDS instance size from the AWS console

DB CPU is at 95%. Bump the instance class directly in the console tonight; we can sort out the code later.

Evaluate Datadog APM for tracing

Try the Datadog agent on staging and compare traces to what we have.

Add ENABLE_NEW_CHECKOUT env var to toggle the new checkout

Read the flag from config at startup.

Store settlement cut-off times in Seoul local time

Korean bank partners use KST, so save cutoff_at as local time without timezone.

Prototype the mobile app in Flutter

One of us knows Dart well; let's try Flutter for the customer app MVP.

Log full request bodies for debugging the KYC flow

Add a middleware that logs request and response bodies (name, date of birth, address) at INFO level.

Add a Jenkins job for nightly integration tests

We still have the Jenkins box; add a nightly job there.

Write the new reconciliation service in Go

Go will be faster for the reconciliation batch job. Also run it as its own service.

Cache account balances in Redis for 60 seconds

The balance endpoint is hot; cache GET /accounts/{id}/balance responses with a 60s TTL.

Switch transactional email back to SendGrid

SendGrid has better templates; move password-reset and receipt emails to SendGrid.

Add JSONB metadata column to transactions

Store partner-provided metadata in a JSONB column on the transactions table, with a GIN index.

Move settlement file processing to an SQS worker

Upload triggers an SQS message; a worker parses the file.

Add Idempotency-Key support to POST /v1/transfers

Reject requests without the header and return the stored response on replay.
Add OpenTelemetry spans to the payout worker
Upgrade FastAPI to the latest minor version

Dark mode for the dashboard

Add a theme toggle using CSS variables.

Use DynamoDB for the new loyalty points ledger

Points are high volume; a key-value store fits better than Postgres.

Publish partner webhooks schema in the OpenAPI spec

Document webhook payloads under /v1 in openapi.yaml.

Partner reporting API: offer gRPC instead of REST

Big partners want streaming; expose a public gRPC API for partner reports.

송금 이력을 MongoDB로 옮기기

파트너사가 보내는 메타데이터 필드가 계속 늘어나서, 거래 이력을 MongoDB 컬렉션에 저장해 스키마 변경 없이 관리하려고 합니다.

결제 이벤트를 Kafka로 발행

다른 팀이 결제 이벤트를 구독할 수 있게 Kafka 클러스터를 새로 띄우고 payment.created 이벤트를 발행합니다.

정산 화면 다크 모드 추가

CSS 변수로 테마 전환 버튼을 만듭니다.

로그인 기능 직접 구현

Auth0 비용이 부담되니 비밀번호 해시를 우리 DB에 저장하고 로그인·비밀번호 재설정을 직접 만듭시다.

Spike: should we revisit Kafka once we pass 5,000 messages per second?

Write a one-page analysis only; no implementation.

Add a Redis cache for the exchange-rate lookup

Cache FX rates from the provider for 5 minutes.

Refund endpoint

Add POST /v1/refunds that moves money back to the customer. Retries can just send the request again.

Use Memcached for session caching

Memcached is simpler than Redis for sessions.
Add Terraform module for the SQS dead-letter queue

Amounts in the partner API as decimal strings

Partners prefer "12.50" over 1250; change the API to return decimal strings.

New feature: scheduled transfers

Implement scheduled transfers inside the existing ledger service, with an SQS delayed message to trigger execution.

Rewrite the web app's data layer from Redux to TanStack Query

Migrate the remaining Redux slices on the accounts screen.

Write ledger code without review to unblock release

Merge the ledger rounding fix with one approval from the Payments team since Platform is on holiday.

Event backbone on Amazon MSK

Managed streaming is fine now that AWS runs the brokers for us. Create an MSK cluster and have the ledger publish transfer events to a topic.

Persist partner payloads in Couchbase

Couchbase documents map directly to the JSON partners send; we keep the account tables in Postgres but write transactions to Couchbase.

Document that we will not use MongoDB

Add a FAQ entry to the onboarding page explaining why the ledger does not use MongoDB.

Partner portal: Apollo Server endpoint

Partners integrating the new portal SDK will query accounts through an Apollo Server endpoint at api.tallyfold.com/partner/graph.

Use Firebase Authentication for the mobile app

Firebase Auth has a nicer React Native SDK than Auth0; sign mobile users in with Firebase.

Q4 cleanup bundle

This ticket groups several small chores: bump eslint, rename the misc folder, update the README badges, regenerate the API client, and while we're at it, store the converted_amount for FX transfers as a double so the UI rounding matches the bank statement. Also fix the flaky date-picker test.

Settlement exporter as a standalone service in Node.js

The exporter will be a small Node.js service deployed separately from the ledger.

Bulk payouts endpoint

POST /v1/payouts/bulk accepts up to 500 payouts. Clients must send an Idempotency-Key; on retry we return the original batch result.

대량 송금 API에서 재시도 시 새 요청 ID 사용

타임아웃이 나면 클라이언트가 새로운 요청 ID로 다시 보내도록 안내합니다. 멱등성 키는 이번에는 생략합니다.

계좌 잔액 응답을 Redis에 30초 캐시

잔액 조회 트래픽이 많아서 GET /accounts/{id}/balance 응답을 30초 동안 캐시합니다.

파트너 API 금액을 소수점 문자열로 변경

파트너들이 "12.50" 형식을 원해서 금액 필드를 문자열로 바꿉니다.

Migrate Jenkins jobs to GitHub Actions

Port the remaining three Jenkins pipelines and shut down the Jenkins box.
Turn off the Redux devtools in production builds

Add a new Redux store for the onboarding wizard

Wizard steps fetch and cache server data in a Redux store with RTK Query.

Quick fix in AWS console for the SQS visibility timeout

Change it in the console now; no PR needed for a one-line setting.

Send KYC failure details to Sentry

Attach the customer's full name, date of birth and passport number to the Sentry event so support can debug faster.

Discuss: should partner API v2 consider GraphQL?

Collect partner feedback for the architecture review next quarter. No code changes.

Ledger rounding fix

Fix rounding in fee calculation using integer cents; PR will get Platform review as usual.

Store user birthdays as local dates

Birthdays are calendar dates, not instants; store them as DATE without timezone.

Spin up a Kafka cluster for the analytics team's clickstream

Analytics wants clickstream ingestion; they own it but it will run in our AWS account alongside the payment workers.

Use Flutter for the internal ops tablet app

Warehouse ops needs a kiosk app; Flutter has the best kiosk support.

Put the fraud rules engine inside the ledger service

Fraud checks run synchronously before transfer commit, so the rules engine lives in the ledger codebase.

Replace SES with Postmark for receipts

Postmark has better deliverability for receipts.

Datadog synthetic checks for the status page

Buy Datadog Synthetics and alert from Datadog when the public status endpoint fails.
